en: Baja - It's been a while, Arcion.
Arcion - Ha ha, three years since that raid on Astania, isn't it? So, what did you want me for?
Baja - The truth is, my daughter Kaja has got herself into trouble.
Arcion - Kaja? That little girl? She was a real tomboy even then. I couldn't do a thing with her, ha ha ha.
Baja - Ha! Not just you; even the Black Prince of the Empire couldn't do a thing with that child.
Arcion - So, has something happened to the little lady...?

Baja - You'll have heard that our company has been struggling lately because of the pirates of Blueseed. This year too, several of our ships were plundered or seized by pirates. As you know, pirates can never truly be wiped out, so since the Pandragon navy was disbanded we've had no choice but to swallow the losses. She couldn't bear watching me fret over it, so she left home to open a new sea route by herself, and we haven't heard from her since.
Arcion - Ha, she really is impossible.

Baja - From what I've learned, a famous geographer named Largo and a navigator named Penelo went with her. Even so, what kind of fool tries something as hard as opening a new route when the seas are this dangerous? I'm sure the Blueseed pirates have captured her.
Arcion - Ah, so you want me to bring the little tomboy home.
Baja - That's right. I know it's dangerous, but you're the only one I can trust.
Arcion - How could I turn my back on you, Baja? There's no time to lose, so I'll set out at once with the Kashmir crew here.
